_comment: The route matrix scanned by frontend/tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts (ADR-0039).
Seeded from claude-code/assets/a11y-routes.json and reconciled against the real route
inventory: the guide ratchet's readerRoutes() in frontend/tests/guide.test.ts, plus the two
API documentation pages FastAPI serves from main.py. Every path here answered 200 on a
running site except /app/404, which answers 404 and renders the error page on purpose.
Everything here is reachable from the CI fixture corpus: Title 16 at 119-99 and 119-102not101.
A route may carry `readyWhen`: a selector the scan waits for before running axe. It is for
pages whose content is rendered by their own script rather than sent as markup — the two
vendored bundles — where `load` fires on a shell and axe would otherwise measure whichever
part of the page had painted by then.

_statesComment: Interactive states. The id is the contract: a.11y.spec.ts maps each id to a setup function and
fails if one declared here has no setup, so a state cannot be listed and quietly not scanned.
Scanned at 1280x900, light theme — the state, not the theme, is what these add.
